alex (sec-eng): Noticed a spike of SCIM decrypt failures for tenant 'zephyr' after last night's KMS alias swap. Users are being created but roles are missing. Anyone saw this?

maria (infra): Yep, alerted at 02:10 UTC. KMS alias pointed to new key version at 01:50 but some envelopes error with MALFORMED_CIPHERTEXT when unwrap attempted.

alex (sec-eng): Example log snippet: 
```
2026-03-22T02:12:03Z ERROR scim-worker: unwrap failed tenant=zephyr user=uid-443 err=MALFORMED_CIPHERTEXT ciphertext_id=env-77
```

jong (devex): Quick question: did the rewrap step run as part of the planned rotation? I thought we had an automated migration.

maria (infra): It didn't. The rotation job only updated the alias; the migration on older envelopes is opt-in and we didn't schedule it. Also noticed the encryptionContext schema changed (we added "tenant_id" field in v2). Old ciphertexts lack that context, KMS refuses to unwrap when context is provided but doesn't match.

alex (sec-eng): Risk: users can authenticate but RBAC layer fails to fetch roles (we rely on unwrapped payload). Plan needed.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20260322-77 severity=medium assignees=@maria,@alex

maria (infra): Mitigation ideas: 1) pause strict role enforcement for tenant 'zephyr' (feature flag) 2) run a controlled rewrap job that attempts legacy unwrap (no context) then re-encrypt with v2 context 3) rotate any tokens found in logs.

jong (devex): Pause flag reduces availability of role-based gating. We should notify CS so they can advise the customer. I'll prepare a short note.

alex (sec-eng): Also: redact logs before any public-facing comms. Found a few debug dumps with emails. We'll rotate scim tokens linked to the pipeline.

maria (infra): Repro steps I'm using: 
```
# trigger repro in staging
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  https://scim.internal/v2/Users -d '{"externalId":"test-ext","userName":"test+zephyr@example.com"}'

# inspect key versions
gcloud kms keys versions list --location=global --keyring=prod-kr --key=scim-wrap-key
```

alex (sec-eng): Root cause hypothesis: alias swap switched pointer to new key version but we didn't run envelope migration; unwrap client previously relied on a permissive parse of encryptionContext. Now we pass tenant_id and KMS rejects mismatches.

maria (infra): Confirmed in logs: many decrypt attempts show encryptionContext=null for those ciphertexts. That matches the old wraps.

jong (devex): Proposed runbook: 
- set FEATURE:SCIM_ROLE_ENFORCE[zephyr]=false (tenant-scoped)
- schedule rewrap job: join multi-region workers, read envelopes, attempt legacy unwrap -> rewrap into v2 context 
- backfill RBAC for created accounts
- scrub/redact logs and rotate any exposed secrets
- add fallback in unwrap client: try unwrap with provided context, if MALFORMED_CIPHERTEXT, try legacy unwrap (no context) and log telemetry at info level
I'll write the runbook doc after we confirm approach.

alex (sec-eng): One more security note: avoid broad fallback that accepts bad contexts silently. Fallback must be explicit and audited. Add a flag to enable legacy unwrap per rotation window.

ops-bot: Update INC-20260322-77: mitigation in progress; rewrap job queued job_id=rewrap-20260322-3

maria (infra): Ran a small staging rewrap batch. Success. Starting prod at reduced concurrency (150/s) and monitoring KMS error rate + auth audit stream.

alex (sec-eng): We completed prod rewrap and re-applied roles via backfill at 03:45 UTC. Re-enabled SCIM_ROLE_ENFORCE for zephyr at 03:50 UTC. Post-checks: no more MALFORMED_CIPHERTEXT in the stream.

jong (devex): Customer comms: sent to Zephyr CS team recommending to pause onboarding for ~30m and confirming issue is resolved.

alex (sec-eng): Follow-ups: 
- add automatic envelope migration to rotation playbook (or run pre-rotation migration)
- add schema-version header to encryptionContext and implement controlled fallback with explicit audit logs
- add sanitizer for dev logs to prevent PII leakage
- create a vulnerability ticket for stack traces leaked in 500 responses

maria (infra): I'll open PRs for the rewrap tooling and the controlled fallback.

ops-bot: INC-20260322-77 status -> resolved.

jong (devex): Thanks team. Will write postmortem and update docs.
